telehealth.title: Online consultations
telehealth.available_sub: See a doctor by video from anywhere — useful before you travel for treatment.
telehealth.mode_label: How would you like to see the doctor?
telehealth.book_sub: Talk to the doctor by video before you come. Every time is shown in your time zone and in the clinic's.
telehealth.tz_help: Detected from your device — change it if it's wrong.
telehealth.times_hint: Large: your time. Small: the clinic's time.
telehealth.name: Full name
telehealth.email_help: Your consultation link is sent to this address.
telehealth.reason_ph: Your symptoms, questions, or the treatment you're considering…
telehealth.files_help: Optional — up to 5 files (PDF, JPEG or PNG, 10 MB each): reports, test results, scans. Only the clinic's medical team can open them.
telehealth.privacy: Your details and files are shared only with the clinic.
telehealth.pay_first: Payment is required before the clinic confirms your consultation.
telehealth.request_received_text: Keep this page — it is your personal consultation page. We'll show here when the clinic confirms it.
telehealth.bookmark_hint: Bookmark this page or keep the link we e-mailed you.

state_text.pending: The clinic will review your request and confirm it.
state_text.awaiting_payment: Your consultation will be confirmed once the clinic receives your payment.
state_text.confirmed: Join from this page at the appointment time.
state_text.completed: This consultation is complete. Thank you.
state_text.cancelled: This consultation was cancelled. Contact the clinic to book another time.

telehealth.join_opens: You can join 10 minutes before the start.
telehealth.join_after_confirm: Joining opens once the clinic confirms your consultation.
telehealth.join_link_help: The doctor uses their own meeting service; it opens in a new tab.
telehealth.device_text: Test them before the consultation so you're ready on time.
telehealth.device_fail: We couldn't use your camera or microphone. Allow access in your browser settings and try again.
telehealth.device_unsupported: Your browser doesn't support video calls. Use a recent Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.
telehealth.privacy_text: The video goes directly and encrypted between you and the doctor, and it is never recorded. Choose a quiet, private place with a stable connection.
telehealth.link_invalid_text: This consultation link is not valid. Check the link in your e-mail or contact the clinic.

call.title: Video consultation
call.waiting_doctor: Waiting for the doctor to join…
call.waiting_patient: Waiting for the patient to join…
call.peer_here: The other side is here — connecting…
call.peer_left: The other side left the call.
call.no_media: Your camera or microphone isn't available — you can still see and hear the other side.
call.play: Tap to turn on the sound
call.closed: The call can't be joined right now.

staff.link_help: Personal link for the patient: date and time in their time zone, payment details and the video call.
staff.mail_off: E-mail isn't set up on this server — copy the link and send it to the patient (e.g. by WhatsApp).
staff.mark_paid_help: Records the payment (an invoice is issued). The consultation stays open until the call.
staff.and_confirm: Also confirm the consultation and send the link
staff.confirm_unpaid: Payment hasn't been recorded yet. Confirm anyway?
staff.confirmed_sent: Confirmed — the link was e-mailed to the patient.
staff.confirmed_nomail: Confirmed. Share the consultation link with the patient.
staff.link_sent: The link was e-mailed to the patient.
staff.link_not_sent: E-mail isn't set up — copy the link instead.
staff.skip_checkin: Online patients don't check in at the front desk — joining the call marks them as arrived.

doctor.section_sub: Video consultations for patients who can't come yet, e.g. from abroad.

method_help.builtin: Video call inside DocBook — nothing to install.
method_help.link: Your own Zoom, Google Meet or Teams link.

doctor.jitsi_missing: Jitsi isn't set up on this server (JITSI_URL), so the built-in call is used.
doctor.windows_help: Optional. Leave every day unticked to offer online consultations during the working hours above. Online and in-clinic appointments never overlap.
doctor.clinic_off: Online consultations are turned off for the clinic. Turn them on in Settings → Clinic page.
doctor.pay_link_help: Optional: a link to your own payment page (PayTabs, bank or wallet). Shown to the patient with the consultation price.

settings.title: Online consultations
settings.sub: Patients, including those abroad, book a video consultation from your clinic page.
settings.doctors_none: No doctor offers online consultations yet — turn it on in each doctor's profile.
settings.pay_required_help: Patients see your payment instructions; your team records the payment, then confirms.
settings.instructions_ph: e.g. Bank transfer to IBAN … or CliQ alias …, then send the receipt on WhatsApp.
settings.instructions_required: Add payment instructions so patients know how to pay.
settings.policy_ph: e.g. Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the consultation.
settings.video_note: The built-in video call needs no extra software. Some mobile networks need a TURN server (ICE_SERVERS); JITSI_URL enables a self-hosted Jitsi.
settings.mail_note: Without e-mail set up, staff share each patient's link from the appointment page.

mail.received_subject: We received your online consultation request — {clinic}
mail.received_intro: Thank you. The clinic will review your request and confirm it by e-mail.
mail.received_pay_intro: Thank you. Your consultation will be confirmed once the payment is received — see the payment instructions below.
mail.confirmed_intro: Your consultation is confirmed. Open the link at the appointment time — you can join 10 minutes early. A calendar file is attached.
mail.reminder_subject: Reminder: your online consultation starts in about an hour — {clinic}
mail.reminder_intro: Your online consultation starts soon. Find a quiet place, check your camera and microphone, and join from the link.
mail.cancelled_intro: Your online consultation was cancelled. Contact the clinic if you'd like another time.
mail.foot: This link is personal — please don't share it.

telehealth.pay_online_link_help: Opens the doctor's payment page in a new tab. The clinic confirms the payment once received.

mine.lead: Turn your online consultations on or off and set the price, length, call method and payment link. When on, they appear on the booking page.

errors_telehealth.TELE_FILE_TOO_BIG: Each file must be 10 MB or smaller.
errors_telehealth.TELE_FILE_TYPE: Only PDF, JPEG and PNG files are accepted.
errors_telehealth.TELE_UPLOAD: The files couldn't be uploaded. Try again.
errors_telehealth.JOIN_CLOSED: The consultation can't be joined right now.
errors_telehealth.TELE_SIGNAL_LIMIT: Too many messages. Try again later.
errors_telehealth.invalid_phone: Enter a valid mobile number for the chosen country.
